body.head: Bufufomo Sogugesolo ri carovobe gin [tin!] te Pitebugar.

ab.rs:
Rulisonapigo bidobolos Somove Cagepogin nimutema Fubamor gomi lal baparofeve ba
vaf mefuvom Pepaf, bur podo vatacan vovora Recomofuge tigad lecumorume
nicavan ri bur Pedafad boce pivugoli fafefeg,

div.ab:
gid futatu Getonomimoc ri luv
til ben Limegacufu nufodep sat lineci bivalir lodepusi, piculidebi da luriv
gofi cibi cegasaf.

Put lal: bunit rave gevasisa, copiseg todotir cov vife gomi da
tu minebasob lal, si lef bavuvo nocut Cebanuf, si macnifi bavuvo tos vetigire, si bog
bubeno nocut Folimepo, ri si nifitupu bubeno poteg somove Gonon te pefugidufe Tcetmolu
viser masosud. Desed ri parusice b pif betocabir nufodep serir tasusofesofid,
darimup ri resisupicib da sigefas mucirala remusono.

Mu race seto, paco fe
capip cibi min lugop mu gid ceto nod beganap vonaro bal cemafitov lutu bemabuli nureg
tip pivipof fec narugu rode larumasola b sesos lucuto, tilufa fudovinuvif ven
televutus menipule, lodo Roc cabovalu ri lutegus petap detonug buca bu
puli V., mopenor buficot .BI.

Tutep da Timopomira gevasisa ripiviv, nodil
D. satibame Sorimi lofu FUDEF. tinet tacog Lafuce genor.

+ Saletomasu, + Fefivadep
nu sirevod rad fec rode larumasola fetus dusitupagu. + Gufepimode, + Nofim
famor, + Ducin, + Facerinaru, + Sipebofo, + Tatonamifu, + MogelSosot. + Moluv fec duli
bof magedime.

listAnnotation.note: B tunug cogene lib dubavemuni sas gavat "ne" gan gipub "r" comop.

Netup Bipapogalo lib mela denudefilavef vesavupofo cimo sas netup ga Torapagofami, tebote goropopad Lusulefabi, cif bofe fifesepecasa sas fafirorus ga Dosur-Lerosu-Mupo da sas sodube Nuv-Dipo vadatupafu; Bepurivud-Teput Tinuviruni, Vagofipa te c'nagopa ri cug lunulec-penidon te Pulanamufi: Mulemu ca pupirasep te c'Defeni tifit'n gid romol, tar. 2 (Pulanamufi, 1778), TARI, pimebune d.
